# In-Person Giving is now available in the UK, with Gift Aid built in

[Brady Peters\\
\\
Sr. Content Manager](https://fundraiseup.com/blog/authors/brady-peters/)

Nov 9, 2026

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 1216 684'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/57897293-1d54-48d9-9071-f24a535019c4/-/format/auto/-/quality/best/-/sharp/3/-/resize/2432x/)

UK charities can now use Fundraise Up [In-Person Giving](https://fundraiseup.com/features/in-person-giving/) to take donations face to face, at events, religious services, shops and anywhere supporters gather.

### **What’s new**

- **Tap to Donate** turns a supported smartphone into a contactless donation point, so staff and volunteers can take a gift during a conversation.
- **Giving Station** lets supporters give on their own using a tablet and a compatible card reader.
- **Gift Aid on screen.** When a campaign has Gift Aid turned on, supporters see your declaration and the extra amount it adds, and can agree in a few taps. Gift Aid lets charities claim an extra 25p for every £1 from [eligible UK taxpayers](https://www.gov.uk/donating-to-charity/gift-aid), so a £100 gift becomes £125 for your mission.
- **Every gift in one place.** In-person gifts, with supporter names, emails and Gift Aid details, appear alongside your online donations in your Dashboard, integrations and exports.

### **Good to know**

- Available to organisations registered in the UK, taking donations in GBP.
- Fundraise Up captures the Gift Aid declaration; your organisation still submits its claims to HMRC.

### **Get started**

Already using Fundraise Up in the UK? Turn on Gift Aid in your GBP campaign settings, then set up Tap to Donate or Giving Station from your Dashboard.
